notes: 25 MHz is the Rev-A baseline because the selected SRAM22 family has published silicon behavior at 1.8 V and 25 MHz. Higher frequencies require LCA-1 integrated STA and silicon evidence.
Macro area excludes halos, channels, standard-cell logic, power grid, fillers, decaps, and routing. It is an early feasibility bound, not final utilization.
The NTT RTL has a separate two-phase SRAM22 implementation that honors the registered single-port read contract; physical promotion remains evidence-gated by integrated hardening.
